author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Eighty-Three! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

A pagan Survival-Horror title with a CoOp twist, PILGRIM puts you in the roles of seven starving survivors washed ashore in their wreck of the ship they fled to the New World on. The haunted shore they find themselves castaway on crawls with horrors and the remnants of their predecesors and winter is coming. Let's check it out!

Check out the free playable demo with STLS HERE: https://buergames.com/pages/pilgrim?srsltid=AfmBOooUQge6BpKarv7M1V-nL5rhezDQeC_2OzNGAHE9MiTTolRtATGo
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 083 - PILGRIM: The Haunted Frontier by Buer Games
